title: Thermostat Heater Control Circuit Open
meaning: DME detected an open circuit in the electric heating element inside the map-controlled characteristic thermostat (BMW N52, N54, N55, N20).
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
Electric radiator cooling fan runs at 100% full speed roaring like a jet engine
Engine running cooler than optimal operating temperature
inspectionSteps: Measure electrical resistance across the two pins of the thermostat electrical heater connector; normal resistance is 12-16 ohms. If open circuit (infinite ohms), internal element has burned out.
Inspect wiring harness to thermostat for heat brittleness or rodent damage near water pump.
Check coolant level in expansion tank.
verifiedFixes: Replace the composite thermostat assembly and aluminum mounting bolts (BMW part 11537549476).

Bleed BMW electric cooling system: Fill coolant, turn ignition on (engine off), set cabin temp to 84°F, fan on low, hold gas pedal to floor for 10 seconds to activate automated 12-minute electric water pump bleed cycle.

title: Valvetronic Eccentric Shaft Sensor Reference Plausibility
meaning: DME detected inconsistent angular position comparison between eccentric shaft magnetic sensors.
symptoms: Drivetrain Malfunction warning
Limp home mode
Engine operates on emergency throttle valve control
inspectionSteps: Inspect eccentric shaft sensor connector for oil soaking from valve cover.
Check Valvetronic servomotor supply fuse.
Test servomotor resistance.
verifiedFixes: Replace oil-soaked Eccentric Shaft Sensor
Replace valve cover gasket and eccentric shaft seal
Relearn Valvetronic stops via ISTA / tool

title: Valvetronic Eccentric Shaft Sensor / Actuator Sluggish Movement
meaning: DME detected sluggish response from Valvetronic eccentric shaft sensor or servomotor on BMW N52, N54, N55, S55 engines.
symptoms: Engine enters Valvetronic fail-safe limp mode (operates on throttle butterfly with sluggish throttle response)
Yellow Half-Engine light illuminated on instrument cluster
Rough idle and clicking noise from valve cover on key-on
inspectionSteps: Remove engine beauty cover and locate eccentric shaft sensor connector on front-top of valve cover.
Unclip electrical connector and inspect male and female pins: if pins are flooded with engine oil, the internal sensor seal has failed, allowing pressurized oil into connector.
Spray connector pins thoroughly with electronic cleaner and inspect wire insulation.
Perform Valvetronic stop limit relearn using scan tool.
verifiedFixes: Clean oil from connector pins and replace the eccentric shaft sensor round rubber valve cover gasket (BMW 11127528242).
If fault returns or sensor tracks are shorted, replace eccentric shaft sensor (Continental VDO OEM) and relearn Valvetronic end stops.
Replace Valvetronic servomotor actuator if internal worm gear is stripped.

title: Fuel Control Mixture Lean (Bank 1 Sensor 1)

symptoms: Engine idle surge / stall on cold morning

inspectionSteps: Smoke test intake system (common DISA valve O-ring, upper/lower intake boots, CCV oil separator hoses).
